goal: Review Blazor components for state handling, authorization, JavaScript interop and rendering cost.
use: Review Blazor components for state handling, authorization, JavaScript interop and rendering cost. Use when Blazor pages or components are added or changed.

steps.note: Read the components. Open the pages, shared components and the interop layer.
Check state. Flag state shared across users in singleton services, and state that is lost on reconnect without a plan.
Check authorization. Pages need the authorization attribute, and components must not rely on hidden UI for protection.
Check interop. Flag JavaScript interop that passes unvalidated data, or calls that are never disposed.
Check rendering. Flag large lists without virtualisation, and state changes that re-render the whole page.
Report. List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix.
